title: NetworkOperatorAlertsResult
description: network.operator-alerts-result@1: the answer of POST /internal/operator/alerts. firing: alerts firing after this report; opened: newly firing (paged); reminded: still firing and paged again (once a day); resolved: no longer firing (a resolved notice sent); notified: notifications created across all recipients (0 when no operator account is found or they switched admin notices off). Errors are { error } bodies (400 for a body that breaks the request contract).
